config.coordinate_system: uniform Cartesian (x,y,z) box [-a,a]^2 x [z_min,z_max) inscribed in the finite cylinder of the saved checkpoints
config.description: Pressure-free primitive Navier-Stokes residual of the E-29 datum on real saved states. The E-29 datum is integrated on a 129x256 grid with the fixed uniform step 1e-6 to the target time 5e-4, and schema-v2 candidates are saved at the exact whole-step offsets -4,-2,-1,0,+1,+2,+4 around it. Reloading those seven archives from disk gives three centered approximations of the same u_t at spacings dt, 2dt and 4dt, from which the order of the time difference itself is measured. On the Cartesian audit box (half_width 0.7, since 0.7*sqrt(2)=0.98995 < r_max=1.0, and the full periodic z extent [0,1)) two different discretizations of the same pressure-free statement are then evaluated: curl of the momentum residual, and the Cartesian vorticity-transport residual. Fine audit shape 64x64x128 with the coarse companion 32x32x64 so that audit truncation is separated from a state defect; interior_margin 4 because these residuals take up to three nested derivatives and the x,y faces carry one-sided closures. The source resolution 129x256 (dr=1/128) is deliberately finer than the fine audit spacing dx=1.4/63, which is what makes the audit-grid refinement orders land near two instead of near one: at 65x128 the same run measures relative RMS 1.35e-3 (curl) and 1.84e-3 (transport) with refinement orders 0.79 and 1.13, i.e. still limited by the bilinear reconstruction of the coarser source grid.
config.interpretation: This closes the pressure-free half of the primitive-residual gap recorded in outputs/hou_snapshot_cartesian_audit_v1/summary.json. It is a resolution-limited floating-point consistency measurement of the discrete trajectory against the Cartesian momentum equation, dominated by the bilinear reconstruction and the audit truncation. It is not a reproduction claim, not a continuum statement, not a singularity candidate and not a proof. The recovered pressure is a scoped least-squares diagnostic and is record-only.
config.normalization_description: Hou finite-cylinder normalization: u1 = u^theta/r, omega1 = omega^theta/r, psi1 = psi^theta/r; the E-29 amplitude 12000 is part of the audited equation and is multiplied by amplitude_scale, which exists only so that reduced-amplitude smoke runs can reuse this schema

units.pressure: dimensionless kinematic pressure (pressure divided by constant density)

description.basis_convention: nodal float64 values on the uniform (r, z) tensor grid, r-major, z endpoint omitted
description.normalization: Hou finite-cylinder normalization: r in [0,1], z period 1, u1 = u^theta/r, omega1 = omega^theta/r, psi1 = psi^theta/r
description.representation: transformed axisymmetric state (u1, omega1, psi1) on a uniform finite-cylinder grid with periodic z

units.omega1: dimensionless inverse length inverse time (omega^theta / r)

metadata.interpretation: floating-point candidate snapshot; not a proof and not evidence of singularity formation
